title: Böğürtlen
description: Pretrained BERTurk embedding similarity baseline. The model receives the predefined character inventory, builds character profile embeddings, compares them with 300-word segment embeddings, and selects the top-k most similar character candidates for each segment. No model training or fine-tuning is performed.
